notes.title: Patch 0.0.5
notes.content:
- Added a hint system whereby players can press spacebar for additional hints, one at a time
- Changed the main menu with revamped buttons and included an animation when clicking New Game or Continue
- Added a camera shake effect when completing a level and a teleportation distortion effect when loading a level
- Fixed some bugs with some of the UI and menus

notes.title: Patch 0.0.3
notes.content:
- Fixed a few bugs
- Finished modifying values for most levels to reduce the amount of randomness and calculations
- Made requirements less stringent for some puzzles to give players more room for error
- Moved whiteboards to puzzle rooms
- Added rooms to some conservation of energy levels to aid in visualization and learning
- Added retractable levers to fluid levels and particle effects to energy transferrers for more immersion
- Changed layout of picture room in level 1.3.6

notes.title: Patch 0.0.2
notes.content:
Hotfix for some bugs including:
- Entrance to puzzle room in 1.3.6 has been fixed
- Bug causing cube to constantly reset in 1.1.7 should be fixed
- Mistakes on the graphs in 1.1.6 have been corrected
- Minor story change to account for Titan being a moon of Saturn

Some quick changes based on feedback:
- Added answers to all levels in the top left of the screen to help with troubleshooting (1.4.4 answer script has a typo. This will be fixed in the next patch)
- Randomization of first half of the levels has been replaced with fixed values and easier calculations
- 1.1.1 has been changed to better explain the detector and cube mechanics
- Camera scripts and texts have been changed to make their use clearer (Chinese translation not done yet)
- Holographic paths have been added to projectile motion levels to give players more guidance

More fixes and changes will be done by next weekend. For now the game should be playable all the way through.
